title: Jesus... I've Prayed For My Brother For Years. 🙏
topic: she has prayed for her brother's comeback for years and hears only 'not yet', not knowing the wait itself is mercy for him

bible.text: The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... I've prayed for my brother for years. 🙏

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: And Your answer still sounds like 'not yet'. Why?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: I'm not slow. Every day you count as delay is a door still open.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: So the wait is mercy for him, not silence for me?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: I'm not willing that any should be lost.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Keep praying. Your voice is part of his comeback.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Send this to someone still praying for someone. 🙏
